presets.name: Qwen Image 2512 — Lightning 4-step
presets.description: Qwen Image 2512 (December 2025 update) with Lightning 4-step distillation. State-of-the-art text rendering + photorealism in 4 sampling steps. ~52GB of model files on the volume; recommended/performance GPU tier (the BF16 UNet alone is 41GB, so 32GB cards won't fit it fully resident).
